$comment: Action for returning the result of a single execution of a function by an extension. Internal action, sent by a function resolver extension back to the function resolver extensions domain. The domain validates the returned value against the schema declared in that extension's function signature.

target.$comment: The return action is sent by a function resolver extension to its own domain, so it targets the domain

timestamp.$comment: Timestamp of the originating function execution request; it correlates this return with the request that caused it

result.$comment: Result of the function execution, validated by the domain against the schema declared in the corresponding extension function signature
